baseline.source: Derived unbundled entry using current source/ layout and revisioned import map

scope: Isolated same-origin unbundled-to-bundled browser upgrade; frozen simulation for exact save checks; real render/input smoke; no full campaign playthrough.
checks: Unbundled loader restores historical save and writes real profile-specific localStorage / IndexedDB recovery snapshots.
Same-origin bundle upgrade preserves exact save bytes, player metadata, puzzle variables and 2/5/10-minute recovery history without import.
Recovery UI loads a pre-upgrade checkpoint; second player remains independent and active selection survives reload.
All five actual levels load scripts, streamed geometry, original actors and render with the bundled runtime.
Bundled desktop gameplay processes real keyboard movement/shooting and active WebGL frames.
Mobile auto-detection, simultaneous touch movement/look and shooting/jump overlay input work through the bundled loader.

benchmark.note: One cold and one warm local-loopback measurement per loader. Timings are observations, not a statistically controlled network benchmark or gameplay FPS claim.
